item.title: 40,000 evacuated as Cyclone Verath makes landfall
item.description: Authorities reported that 40,000 people were evacuated. A district official said power supply was disrupted in coastal areas.

item.title: City council approves new bus corridor along the eastern ring road
item.description: The council approved a 14 km bus corridor. Work is expected to begin in November, an official said.
